title: Spicy Jagged Cheese Azifa
description: A traditional Ethiopian-inspired dish with a twist of savory spices and melted cheese.
instructions: Melt the shredded jagged cheese in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add the savory spice mix, olive oil, salt, and black pepper to the cheese sauce. Stir until combined.
Add the fresh azifa to the cheese sauce and stir until coated.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with additional shredded cheese.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
